title: The Lost Ox
sceneText:
At midday somebody comes running up to say the west holding has lost one of its oxen.

It is their plough ox, not the estate’s. But the land around here runs together, and once an ox is lost, looking for it means going across several people’s fields.

effects.logEntry: You sent two men to look for the west holding’s lost ox.

choices.resultText:
It was found by dusk. The ox was cropping grass at the edge of the north woods, none the worse.

The family came to thank you, and said so a great many times. You told them there was no need.

Inside three days every tenant household had heard about it.

choices.text: Let them look for it themselves

effects.logEntry: The west holding lost an ox, and you left them to look for it themselves.

choices.resultText:
They looked for it all day. At dusk the ox came back on its own; an ox knows the road home.

The next day you saw the family out in the fields. They greeted you the way they always do.

Nothing happened at all.
